subtasks: Arrange the five nesting dolls in a row from left to right, from smallest to largest.

Use the left arm to move the medium-sized doll from the far left into the third position, to the right of the two smaller dolls and aligned with their bases. Leave both smaller dolls upright and in place.

Use the right arm to place the second-largest doll from the front right into the fourth position immediately to the right of the medium doll, with its base aligned with the three smaller dolls. Keep the dolls upright and separated.

Use the right arm to move the largest doll, currently behind the right end of the row, forward and to the right into fifth position. Align its base with the four smaller dolls, leave a clear gap, then release it upright and return both arms open to their initial poses.
